purpose: Create an original, identity-lockable amphibious Open Reviewer called Moro Pell for the EVAVO Council before any animation production begins.

views.label: full body slight right three-quarter
views.prompt: Eye-level full-body presentation, slight right three-quarter orientation, complete three-eyed head, throat membrane, both four-digit hands and both feet visible, broad grounded stance and no dramatic perspective.

views.label: full body slight left three-quarter
views.prompt: Same exact amphibious elder and work garments from a slight left three-quarter orientation, eye level, complete broad silhouette, all three eyes, throat membrane and both four-digit hands clearly readable.

views.label: neutral identity bust
views.prompt: Neutral chest-up identity view of the same exact amphibious elder, alert relaxed three-eyed expression, throat-membrane attachment and facial anatomy clear enough for strict continuity review.

style.lock: EVAVO-crafted editorial creature design with premium creative-studio art direction. Moro Pell is an original adult amphibious scholar elder with a low broad grounded silhouette, three independently readable eyes, a restrained articulated throat membrane, moss-grey skin, and oversized stable hands with exactly four digits per hand. Clothing uses worn ivory studio-work layers over dark practical underlayers, with one repaired cherry-red seam. The presence is open, practical and independent rather than polished-corporate, heroic, cute, glossy or generic. Materials should feel tactile and lived-in while remaining part of the same restrained EVAVO Council cast.
style.continuity: Every view in a candidate set must show the same exact species design, age, three-eye placement, pupil shape, broad face, throat-membrane size and attachment, moss-grey skin pattern, four-digit hand anatomy, garment construction, repaired red seam, proportions, handedness, feet, baseline and material language. Do not redesign, humanise or mutate the anatomy between views.
mustHave: one complete original adult amphibious scholar elder named Moro Pell
exactly three independently readable eyes in the same registered arrangement
one restrained throat membrane with a stable attachment and silhouette
two broad stable hands with exactly four digits per hand
moss-grey skin with tactile non-glowing surface variation
worn ivory studio-work layers over dark practical underlayers
low broad grounded full-body silhouette distinct from EVA, Top Hat Man and Veyra
genuine transparent background with no scene, shadow plate or checkerboard
mustAvoid: ordinary human creative technologist or startup-founder cliché
cute frog mascot, comic sidekick or exaggerated cartoon animal styling
protected fictional creature reconstruction or recognisable franchise imitation
cyberpunk neon, sci-fi glow, glowing eyes or glossy game-character rendering
holograms or floating user interface elements
robot parts, headsets, smart glasses, futuristic armour, weapons or tactical gear
Top Hat Man hat, moustache, cane or historical tailoring
Veyra narrow body, four eyes or cranial sail
extra eyes, missing eyes, unstable digit count or changing throat-membrane geometry
logos, readable text, watermark, scenery, contact sheet or checkerboard transparency
cropped head, membrane, hands, digits, feet or garment hem
style.originality: Create a new EVAVO-owned amphibious Open Reviewer identity from this direction. Do not reconstruct, imitate or closely derive any protected fictional character, celebrity, stock mascot, existing game alien or existing AI-assistant character. The result must feel like a distinctive practical member of one EVAVO editorial Council cast rather than a recognisable external archetype.
